title: 2016 AMC 10A Problem 3
statement: For every dollar Ben spent on bagels, David spent \(25\) cents less. Ben paid \(\$12.50\) more than David. How much did they spend in the bagel store together?

solutions.text:
For each dollar Ben spent, David spent \(75\) cents, so the difference was \(25\) cents. The total difference \(\$12.50\) is therefore one quarter of Ben’s spending.

Ben spent \(12.50\div0.25=50\) dollars, and David spent \(37.50\) dollars. Together they spent \(87.50\) dollars.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: David spends \(75\) cents for each dollar Ben spends
The difference is one quarter of Ben’s spending
